parameters.name: planning_horizon
parameters.description: Single planning horizon over which the hiring decision is made

parameters.name: candidate_count
parameters.description: Number of candidates in the candidate set

parameters.name: experience
parameters.description: Work experience value of each candidate

parameters.name: advanced_degree_flag
parameters.description: Binary advanced-degree indicator for each candidate

parameters.name: budget
parameters.description: Total budget cap for selected candidates

parameters.name: minimum_advanced_degree_hires
parameters.description: Minimum number of selected candidates with advanced degree flag equal to 1

parameters.name: minimum_total_experience
parameters.description: Minimum total experience required among selected candidates

parameters.name: incompatible_pairs
parameters.description: Set of unordered incompatible candidate pairs

variables.name: selection
variables.description: Binary selection variable indicating whether each candidate is selected

variables.name: selected_candidates
variables.description: Selected subset of candidates induced by the selection vector

constraints.name: binary_selection_domain
constraints.description: Each candidate is either selected or not selected

constraints.name: hire_count_bounds
constraints.description: The number of selected candidates must lie between the minimum and maximum hire limits

constraints.name: budget_cap
constraints.description: The total hiring cost of selected candidates must not exceed the budget cap

constraints.name: minimum_advanced_degree_hires
constraints.description: At least the required number of selected candidates must have advanced degree flag equal to 1

constraints.name: minimum_total_experience
constraints.description: The total work experience of selected candidates must be at least the required minimum

constraints.name: incompatible_pair_exclusion
constraints.description: For every incompatible pair, both candidates cannot be selected together

objectives.name: total_hiring_cost_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize the total hiring cost of the selected candidates

final_objective.description: Minimize the total hiring cost of the selected candidates using the binary selection vector over the candidate set.
